reason: As someone who has quit three services, A answers my real worries: no contract, skip or cancel any time, swap meals, a call with the dietitian, and a concrete order deadline, while being plain about what the A1C numbers can't prove. B has a "Real results" headline that oversells, an unfilled "[day/time]" placeholder, an unsupported "people stay because the food is good" claim, and says nothing about cancelling.
